bestBets.overview: A nice race to kick off the day. Keen to side with the Chris Waller-trained WONKA here fresh, debuted in a very smart 2yo race before going for a spell. Brought back with impressive trials and looks very well placed here over 1300m. SKYSTONE has had plenty of market support at every run this preparation and has that again here. This looks to be his best opportunity yet, peaking fourth up and sticking to the 1300m. Expect him to be right in the thick of the finish. ARGANSORT will only be better for that debut effort, can improve here. ODINS EYE is next best.

raceTips.comment: Potentially a strong maiden. Wonka was solid with excuses on debut last prep noting the winner of said race subsequently won in stakes grade. He found the line well in a recent trial. Odin's Eye was good to/through the line in a recent trial effort and can utilise a low barrier. Skystone has been gallant in defeat with two recent seconds and won't stay a maiden for long. Adaptation strips fitter from a solid resuming effort.

bestBets.overview: ZARAGOZA produced an improved performance second up, and history suggests he peaks third up. He loves racing at this track and is good enough to win. A proven first up performer gives me confidence in having GUNROOM on top. He has had a nice tick over trial leading into this and looks ready to fire. Drawn well in barrier 3, he should use his gate speed to roll forward and prove hard to run down. CMON MATE is another proven first up performer who resumes after 20 weeks and can be charging home late. SATNESS looks the likely leader but may benefit from the run and appears better suited later in the preparation.

raceTips.comment: Gunroom has a good record over this distance range and tends to race well first up. Adding to that, he is very likely to have a tactical advantage in running over other key runners in the race. One of whom is Zaragoza who is ready to peak third up and will be running on hard. Up The Front is another backmarker who will be strong late and best efforts are good enough, but he hasn't won for a long time. C'mon Mate next best.
